verdict.rationale: Kick documents Plaid connectivity to 12,000+ banks/credit cards as the primary import method, with daily-syncing transactions feeding automatic AI categorization (~97% first-pass) and real-time P&L updates, plus a fallback Universal Importer for unsupported institutions. Security docs confirm credentials never touch Kick servers, reinforcing trustworthy bank-linking. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on verification of daily sync reliability or edge-case failures, and no explicit confirmation of sync frequency cadence beyond 'daily' framing in the story.
